issue: ढाल कृपाल धनुष अति भाता — in a list of arms (shield, ?, bow) कृपाल ('merciful') hardly fits; कृपाण ('sword') would. The book and Drik Panchang both print कृपाल; a web search found only Bhakti Bharat (a copy of Drik Panchang).
our reading: ढाल कृपाल धनुष अति भाता (as printed)

issue: With कृपाल as printed, the meaning reads it as an address (हे कृपालु! / O merciful one) between the arms.
our reading: O merciful one, the shield and the bow are most pleasing
alternatives: (with कृपाण) the shield, sword and bow are most pleasing
